payload.prompt: When you feel stuck, what do you try to regain first?

choice_a.label: A destination to move toward
choice_a.plain_language_meaning: You naturally look for a direction worth moving toward.

choice_b.label: One clean fork chosen
choice_b.plain_language_meaning: You regain movement by choosing a clear fork and committing to it.

payload.operational_contrast: Horizon Signal centers on “A destination to move toward” through finding direction; Fracture Path centers on “One clean fork chosen” through decisions under pressure. Notice which describes your first instinct in this situation—not which sounds better.
payload.boundary: This comparison does not rank, select, or record either choice.
